The infected balls

There was once a factory of balls, later termed spherical items, owned by a wealthy businessman named Ykcir Aseporo. The factory produced spherical items of different colors and sizes.

One day, the items became infected, causing them to shrink and become heavier. Thankfully, some remained uninfected.

To save the factory, Mr. Aseporo of Gold Group of Companies hired designers to create a ball sorter that would separate the contaminated spherical items from the uninfected ones.

The designers are G8 students of PSHS-BRC.
